headline: Roku's first OLED TVs are up to $400 off, starting at $699
summary: Roku's new OLED TVs are heavily discounted, starting at just $699. The 55-inch Pro Series model features a 120Hz OLED panel. This deal makes an already impressive TV even more affordable.

headline: Phones don’t have lights
summary: Mark Zuckerberg defends Ray-Ban Meta glasses' privacy features. He argues the glasses' signal light for photos is superior to phones. Phones lack a clear visual indicator when capturing images.

headline: These camera apps give you more control over the iPhone 18 Pro’s aperture
summary: iPhone 18 Pro's native camera app limits aperture settings to four. Third-party apps offer greater control for photographers. Unlock your iPhone's full photographic potential with these alternatives.

headline: Tesla’s Optimus robot is going through growing pains
summary: Tesla's Optimus robot production is struggling to meet targets. Repurposed Model S/X lines are causing manufacturing snags. Tesla is reportedly producing only "several hundred robots a week."

headline: Try IGN's Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown Checklists for Free During Nintendo's September Game Trial
summary: IGN offers free checklists for Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. Access them during Nintendo's September Game Trial. Enhance your gameplay experience without extra cost.

headline: The LEGO Animal Crossing Creative Houses Set Has Hit a New Low Price at Amazon Thanks to a Coupon
summary: LEGO Animal Crossing Creative Houses set is now $47.21 on Amazon. This is a new low price, a 48% discount. Grab this deal with a coupon on the store page.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Will Be Easier to Platinum Than Rebirth
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is expected to have an easier Platinum trophy. This offers a less challenging achievement for completionists. Compared to Rebirth, achieving 100% will be simpler.

headline: The HP OMEN GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,899 During the Walmart GeForce Week Sale
summary: The HP OMEN GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC is on sale for $1,899. This deal is part of Walmart's GeForce Week Sale. Enjoy 60fps+ gaming at 4K resolutions with this powerful PC.

headline: What could the potential sanctions for Man City be?
summary: Manchester City found guilty of breaking 115 financial rules. Football finance expert expects "significant" sanctions. Potential penalties for the club remain a major talking point.

headline: I'm not tempted to call an early election, Burnham says
summary: Prime Minister states no temptation to call an early election. An early poll would be a "backward-looking process." The current focus is on avoiding political disruption.

headline: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
summary: FBI hack compromised special agents' blood and urine test results. Experts warn of vulnerability to scams, blackmail, and targeted attacks. The breach raises significant security concerns for agents.

headline: Some BBC channels and radio stations may well have to close, director general says
summary: BBC Director General warns some channels and stations may close. This potential closure is due to the BBC's financial situation. The future of specific services is under review.
